item.title: Evaluation of Apache Kylin 1.5.4.1 with HDP 2.5, performance comparison w Hive
item.description: Apache Kylin is a data cube solution on top of Hadoop providing an ODBC interface for BI tools. OLAP cubes boost performance for analytics via using a subset of data, enriched with pre-calculations on specific dimensions of interest. It enables loading dimensions from a Hive data source, therefore accelerating BI tool access via pre-calculating data and adding it to HBase.
